items.headline: CTRM software market sizing report released
items.summary: Commodity Technology Advisory published its 2026 CTRM Software Market Sizing Report, estimating the global market at $2.138bn in 2026, growing to $2.452bn by 2030 at a 3.6% CAGR.

items.headline: UK EMIR Phase II reconciliation deadline nears
items.summary: UK EMIR Phase II reconciliation, adding numerous new fields and matching tolerances, is now scheduled to begin around September 28, 2026, following an April technical update from the Bank of England and FCA.

items.headline: Diesel supply strain lifts freight cost pressure
items.summary: Global diesel supplies have tightened since renewed US-Israel-Iran conflict, pushing Brent crude up sharply on September 1 and adding cost pressure across trucking and freight operations, per Transport Topics.

items.headline: Carriers plan phased return to Suez Canal
items.summary: A major container alliance is reportedly running ad-hoc Suez Canal sailings through the rest of 2026 as part of a risk assessment, with regular transits planned from January 2027, per Journal of Commerce.
